paper_id: Wang et al. - 2016 - Towards Energy Efficient Duty-Cycled Networks Analysis, Implications and Improvement
title: Towards Energy Efficient Duty-Cycled Networks: Analysis, Implications and Improvement
motivation: 1200节点CitySee网络实测发现现有duty-cycling协议在真实流量下能耗远高于小规模测试预期
problem_framing: 将协议参数(t_s,t_w,t_d)与数据率λ的联合优化问题形式化为平均每包能耗最小化
key_insight: 同一参数设置在不同数据率下效果相反:低速率应设小t_w/t_d,高速率反之;需联合优化发送端和接收端能耗
method_signature: LAD协议:基于泊松流量模型推导最优参数,离线预计算Lookup表供在线查询
evaluation_criteria: 能耗降低百分比(对比TinyOS LPL MAC、X-MAC等);节点duty cycle ratio分布
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: TinyOS LPL MAC默认参数在特定场景下导致very poor performance,ContikiMAC并不总是energy efficient
evidence_for_taste: using the same parameter setting results in totally different performance
a small tw and td, which is preferred in (a), is prohibited in (b)
fixed settings...may lead to a very poor performance
state-of-the-art protocols with empirical parameters are not adequate
thinking_moves: 从1200节点运营网络实测异常反推理论分析必要性
先推导解析公式(Theorem 1)作为设计准则,再实例化到TinyOS LPL
用泊松分布简化后验算,再通过真实数据验证分布假设
将在线优化计算转化为离线预计算+查表以适应资源受限节点
